```yaml
name: i18n-check

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  i18n-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Fetch base branch
        env:
          BASE_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
        run: |
          echo "Fetching base branch $BASE_BRANCH"
          git fetch origin "$BASE_BRANCH"

      - name: Set up JDK 17
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17

      - name: Build and test
        run: mvn -B clean compile test

      - name: Detect base-only files
        id: detect_base_only
        env:
          BASE_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "Detecting base-only files..."
          BASE_CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only origin/"$BASE_BRANCH"...HEAD)
          OURS_CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only HEAD...origin/"$BASE_BRANCH")
          BASE_ONLY=$(echo "$BASE_CHANGED" | grep -v -f <(echo "$OURS_CHANGED"))
          echo "Base-only files:"
          echo "$BASE_ONLY"
          echo "base_only_files<<EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "$BASE_ONLY" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "EOF" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Enforce mandatory answer-session policy
        env:
          BASE_ONLY_FILES: ${{ steps.detect_base_only.outputs.base_only_files }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$BASE_ONLY_FILES" ]; then
            echo "No base-only files detected."
          else
            echo "Base-only files detected: $BASE_ONLY_FILES"
            echo "Failing due to mandatory policy: never take ours for base-only files."
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Post-rebase regression scan
        env:
          BASE_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.ref }}
          BASE_ONLY_FILES: ${{ steps.detect_base_only.outputs.base_only_files }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if [ -n "$BASE_ONLY_FILES" ]; then
            while IFS= read -r file; do
              if ! git diff --quiet "$BASE_BRANCH" -- "$file"; then
                echo "Regression detected: $file differs from base branch."
                exit 1
              fi
            done <<< "$BASE_ONLY_FILES"
          fi
          DELETED=$(git diff --name-status origin/"$BASE_BRANCH"...HEAD | grep '^D' | awk '{print $2}')
          if [ -n "$DELETED" ]; then
            echo "Unintended deletions detected:"
            echo "$DELETED"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "No regressions detected."
```
